title: Lock files and checksum files
summary: Twenty snippets of package-lock.json, yarn.lock, go.sum and similar dependency lock files, each line carrying an integrity hash.
rationale: Integrity hashes are long, random-looking, base64 or hexadecimal, and public. Lock files are large and committed in nearly every project, so any weakness here multiplies.
unscopedReason: Authored detector and arrival-target metadata intentionally assign no credential family; this fixture remains a global benchmark control.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged. The hashes verify published packages and are public by design.
